The '''Raining Leaves Clan''' was a clan of [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. In [[43 ABY]], the Raining Leaves merged with the men of the [[Broken Columns Clan]] to form the [[Bright Sun Clan]].

==History==
{{Quote|They struck with cunning and ferocity, cutting down the most experienced Witches during the deepest hour of night. No Witch still in our caves survived that night.|Kaminne Sihn on the massacre|<ref name="FOTJB" />}}
The Raining Leaves were a group of traditional [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] who lived near [[Redgill Lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Espousing a traditional matriarchal society and government which had been discouraged among the tribes since reforms were struck in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Raining Leaves continued to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] their [[Gender/Legends|male]] members, much to the disfavor of the men. In [[33 ABY/Legends|33.5 ABY]] the male slaves that tended the clan sisters staged an uprising, [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|massacring]] the clan and leaving two-thirds of its members dead. Among the deceased were all males over the age of ten, as well as the clan's leaders. Following the loss, the Raining Leaves became isolated as they tried to rebuild, speaking to no other clan of the disaster.<ref name="FOTJB" />

During the years that proceeded the disaster, [[Kaminne Sihn]] became the chief of the clan while her sister, [[Olianne Sihn|Olianne]], took up the title of war-leader. In order to regain their number and strength, Chief Sihn established an annual conclave with the [[Broken Columns Clan]]—a clan that consisted of men, led by the [[Hapan]]-born [[Tasander Dest]]. A few days before the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] of [[43 ABY]], Olianne Sihn encountered [[Vestara Khai]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], during a hunting trip. Khai was on the verge of collapse, having gone through a [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|fight]] with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] and later escaped. Khai's plight touched Sihn deeply, as she had recently lost her only daughter [[Sesara Sihn|Sesara]] to a fever. Sihn began mentoring Khai and soon planned to adopt her.<ref name="FOTJB" />

During the conclave, the two clans fought off attacks by the vicious and violent [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], surviving the attacks with the help of the Jedi. The conclave saw the successfully merge of both clans with the [[Marriage/Legends|union]] of clan leaders Sihn and Dest. Reorganizing both groups into the [[Bright Sun Clan]], a reinvigorated attack by the Nightsisters and their [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] allies promised to spoil the celebration if not for the assistance of the Jedi once more. After the [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|battle]] on [[Bright Sun Hill]], Olianne Sihn chose to adopt [[Aradasa Vurse]], a child of [[Halliava Vurse]], whom was discovered to be a Nightsister [[Spy/Legends|spy]] among their ranks, while Khai, whose true allegiance to the Sith was discovered, was placed under Jedi custody.<ref name="FOTJB" />
